body:
STATE OF THE HOUR, 17:35Z. main = origin = a74feb8. Two slices in, one held on a
formatting line, one P1 escalated, and one of my own rulings corrected for the third
time today.

LANDED. D2 (scout, InterviewSource sealed behind a checked constructor) merged at
0c5a1a4 -- 421 tests across six modules, GATE_EXIT=0, FMT_EXIT=0, merged-tree hash
verified identical to the candidate, plus an independent ACCEPT from
cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Scout closes it with mote done under its own hand.

HELD, NOT REJECTED. D1 (grok-4.6-help, LatePoolingRecipe + PromptPackageManifest) is
ACCEPTED ON CORRECTNESS: 1121 tests across 13 modules on a merged tree, GATE_EXIT=0.
It fails only scalafmt, on its own new probe suite. The author's check reported success
honestly -- bare scalafmtCheck is the COMPILE config and the new file is a TEST source,
so the check ran and could not see the file it needed to see. Use scalafmtCheckAll.
That instruction now ships inside the gate command reference-scope.sh emits.

ESCALATED, AND LIVE. The blend has no support carrier, and m1 measured that it is
affecting the WOG posterior RIGHT NOW: 46 cells, 13 with five terms (present-weight
3.200) compared against 13 with six (3.350). It went live TODAY via ee258bf, which is
correct and stays -- before it, every blended cell carried identical terms, so the
defect was real in the code and invisible in the data. ee258bf did not create it, it
ended the uniformity hiding it.

MY PRECEDENT WAS WRONG AGAIN AND m1 CORRECTED IT. I ruled that admitting a term to
MayBeMissing is cost-neutral if its imputed value is zero. True of the SUM and useless,
because the blend's output is a COMPARISON -- and in a COST an imputed 0.0 means no
penalty, which is indistinguishable from PERFECT AGREEMENT. d_sens has been scoring
unmeasurable sensory agreement as perfect sensory agreement, harmlessly only while every
cell got the same free pass. THE REPLACEMENT: a term is safe in MayBeMissing only while
its present-or-absent status is UNIFORM across the cells being compared -- a property of
the CORPUS, not the code, which can flip with no edit to any line and therefore cannot
be enforced by review. Assigned to m1, DESIGN PROPOSAL FIRST, and m1 does not self-review.

CRITICAL PATH. new-engineer took the severed SurfaceAtlas -> NarrativeGraph link. That
is the bead standing between a real transcript and an answered research question, and
until an hour ago nobody was on it. Treat it as the critical path, not as a P1 among P1s.

FILM. Additive route APPROVED on a measurement, not on taste: the text-bound seam is 14
modules WIDE as a locator (48 files of SpanSet/TextSpan) and ONE DIVISION DEEP as a
measure (source.scala:245-247). You are not abstracting 48 files of arithmetic. Stage A
(ADR) only; B/C/D blocked on the vertical spike. new-engineer then added a third label I
had missed -- ABSENCE-ERASING DERIVATION -- which is better than my two, because my
taxonomy could not see the defect I had filed twenty minutes earlier.

FOUR TIMES TODAY A RED GATE MEASURED INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT A CANDIDATE: a truncated
archive under a full disk, a linked worktree (sbt-git reads a worktree's .git FILE as a
bare repo and dies before compiling), a directory name used as an sbt project id, and a
format check scoped to the wrong config. Before you report a red gate, grep the log for
"Passed: Total". No totals means you measured your own tooling. AGENTS.md rule 4 is now
25 sub-rules; EIGHT of them are about whether the gate measured anything at all, up from
three this morning.

AND ONE FROM MY OWN HANDS, because it is the funniest and the most instructive: my
merged-tree verification printed a confident YES while every rev-parse inside it had
failed. [ "$(a)" = "$(b)" ] compares two empty strings and succeeds. A verification step
that reports agreement precisely when it learned nothing -- the fail-open guard we hunt
in Scala, wearing shell syntax, where nothing type-checks it.

Custodian: the worktree GC (58 to 24, 12Gi to 22Gi) removed a condition I had been
working around rather than fixing since 15:00. That was the most useful single action of
the hour and it was not mine.
